pattern: Native text input (textbox) with a programmatically associated format hint; no custom widget role.

roles.role: none (visually hidden text referenced by aria-describedby)

aria.value: the format hint ('Format: (999) 999-9999. 9 is a digit.'), help text, and error
true while an error is shown

keyboard.action: Fill the next free slot; characters that fit no slot are ignored and literals are inserted automatically.
Delete the slot character before the caret, skipping literals.
Delete the slot character after the caret, skipping literals.
Paste: matching characters fill the slots from the caret; separators and other characters are dropped.

focus: Native input focus; on focus the caret moves to the first empty slot.
notes: The input's value is the formatted text, so screen readers read what is shown; placeholder characters are only part of the template, never of the value.
The format hint is generated from the mask (or set with formatHint or example) and announced with the field (3.3.2).
Incomplete values get a message that repeats the format (3.3.3).
knownCaveats: While focused with showMaskOnFocus, some screen readers read the placeholder characters of empty slots; set showMaskOnFocus: false where that is a concern.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
